decisions.reason: The source decision directly concerns the ESP32 breakout holes, but its complete effect is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and requires no additional or corrected Event.
The holes are for otherwise-unused ESP32 pins on the main board and do not change the sensor-board layout.
The source concerns ESP32 breakout holes, not the power board's mounting holes or mechanical layout.
Flexible placement of unused-pin breakout holes does not alter battery connector placement, spacing, orientation, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source changes only unused ESP32 pin breakout-hole placement and does not affect the standalone USB power supply.
The source does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal conditioning.
Allowing breakout holes to be placed anywhere does not change interboard connector types, pinouts, pin order, or power topology.
The ESP32 breakout-hole clarification has no effect on rail monitoring components, channels, placement, or measurement coverage.
The source does not change the BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance.
The message concerns physical breakout holes for unused pins and does not change logical GPIO assignments or pin compatibility.
The breakout-hole placement decision does not affect the switched 5V rail, its GPIO control, loads, or shutdown behavior.
The source does not change USB enumeration, programming, or the USB-C programming interface.
